sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Shri Santosh Yadav, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the appeal instituted by the petitioner under Section 734 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, has been admitted and registered as FSMA No. 90 of 2020, Grand Bakers Vs. State of U.P., before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal/Sessions Judge, Agra.

entities.text: Grand Bakers Vs. State of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Food Safety Appellate Tribunal/Sessions Judge, Agra
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The only submission is that the precondition of deposit of 60% of the penalty amount imposed by the appellate court is onerous and renders the appeal illusory.
In light of the preceding submissions, interests of justice will be served by permitting the petitioner to deposit 30% of the penalty amount.
The impugned order is accordingly modified.
With the aforesaid observation, the writ petition is disposed of.
